newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end off, more volatility foreseen.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end off, more volatility foreseen.

text.p: 1450 GMT - Dutch shares close a little lower after a volatile session and dealers foresee more volatility in the coming days as result of option expiry on Friday and uncertainty about interest rates. ASM Lithopraphy strongly outperforming market, but Akzo Nobel and Nutricia sink further after yesterday's overall fall.
* AEX share index closes 0.17 points lower at 935.59.
* ASM Lithography end 13.40 guilders higher at 183.90
on the back of strong gain on the U.S. market overnight.
